formula: Exact edge_center_atlas.classify order: PD-only if PD < min(LE,mu)*(1-tol); then LE <= mu*(1+tol) and LE <= PD*(1+tol); then micro. Censored PD/LE loads are +infinity; raw Bloch root retained in classifier even when near-Gamma censored for window reporting.
rounding_note: A gap > tol is not identical to PD < LE*(1-tol); boundary counts can differ. No rounding before classification.
